source_title: Gartner Says Worldwide PC Shipments Increased 1.4% in Fourth Quarter of 2024 and 1.3% for the Year

claim_relevant_segments.annual_shipments: Worldwide PC shipments totaled 245.4 million units in 2024

claim_relevant_visible_text:
1.3% year-over-year
Worldwide PC shipments totaled 245.4 million units in 2024
researcher_paraphrase: Gartner's January 2025 preliminary full-year estimate put 2024 PC shipment growth at 1.3% and volume at 245.4 million units.
precision_guard: This is Gartner's preliminary shipment estimate based on sell-in to channels; final statistics may differ. It can support an Outcome evaluation only against comparable Gartner PC shipment forecasts.
authority_boundary: Gartner is authoritative for its own preliminary market measurement and methodology scope.
